name: UGC hook · talking head
description: A short vertical talking-head hook spoken straight to a phone camera by one of your characters, with native audio. Use it to test a hook line before committing to a full ad.
prompt: {{ creator }} speaks straight to a phone camera in a plain daylight room, mid shot, natural gestures, and says exactly: "{{ hook }}" and nothing else. Phone-camera realism, true skin texture, even light, deep focus. No captions, no text on screen, no music.
negative_prompt: captions, on-screen text, watermark, studio lighting, extra people

slots.name: hook
slots.label: Hook line
slots.help: The one sentence they say. Keep it under about twelve words.

author: kilnry
